name: OR-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strongly Democratic district with a +20 partisan lean
Incumbent Suzanne Bonamici seeking re-election with a large financial edge
Challenger Barbara Kahl has raised only about $4,500 with minimal cash on hand
Prediction markets price Bonamici at roughly 97% to win
model.rationale: The district's +20 Democratic lean, Bonamici's incumbency, and an overwhelming fundraising advantage of roughly $817,000 to $4,500 leave the Republican challenger with no visible path. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win.
model.watch: Any late surge of outside spending against Bonamici or a major scandal would be the only plausible route to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Suzanne Bonamici, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Portland-area district that leans about 20 points Democratic. She has raised more than $816,000 and holds over $570,000 in cash, while Republican Barbara Kahl has raised under $5,000 and reports just a few hundred dollars on hand. No outside spending has been reported on either side, and no expert ratings or general-election polls are available for the race.

Prediction markets give Bonamici roughly a 97% chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no polling, the forecast rests on the partisan lean, incumbency, and the stark resource gap, all of which point to a comfortable incumbent victory.
